parameters.description: Workspace ID for routing and authorization.
parameters.name: workspaceId

parameters.description:
Label selector expressions of the form "key=value". Multiple selectors
are ANDed; each is an exact-match equality on one label. At most 8
selectors; duplicate keys are rejected (they can never match under AND).
Bare keys without "=" are invalid (reserved for a future existence
operator).
parameters.name: labelSelectors

parameters.description:
Which ownership scope to list. Defaults to the caller's own sessions.
Encoded on the REST surface as a query parameter, by enum name
(?scope=SESSION_LIST_SCOPE_WORKSPACE).

 - SESSION_LIST_SCOPE_UNSPECIFIED: Defaults to SESSION_LIST_SCOPE_MINE.
 - SESSION_LIST_SCOPE_MINE: Sessions owned by the calling user.
 - SESSION_LIST_SCOPE_WORKSPACE: Sessions owned by the workspace itself (owner_type "workspace") —
visible to and manageable by every member of the workspace.
parameters.name: scope
